title: elymus plurinervis
intro: Elymus plurinervis, commonly known as the many-veined wheat grass, is a type of grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. It is a perennial plant that has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Elymus plurinervis include soothing digestive issues, relieving stress and anxiety, and supporting immune function. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
